## What the model says

Class, attribute or scenario, with its current confidence.

## Why it looks wrong

## Primary source

URL, retrieval date. A source is required — "it seems wrong" is a discussion,
not an issue.

## Proposed confidence

- [ ] `validated` — corroborated by a tier 1 source
- [ ] `corrected` — the model was wrong and this is the fix
- [ ] `notVerified` — downgrade, cannot be confirmed
